name: tab-list-scroll-follows-the-fingers
description: A vertical trackpad gesture over the tabs list scrolls it by the distance the fingers travelled. The zone's wheel handler applies mid-list deltas to scrollTop itself: leaving them to native scrolling made the outcome a per-gesture race (the diagnostic probe read 0px from 300px gestures whose every event reached the page, while an identical planted div scrolled 300 on one run and 0 on the next). The sampler sums the deltas the page received and compares them to the scrollTop movement, so the assertion is 'the list followed the fingers', not a magic pixel count.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot

actions.expression: (() => { const z = document.querySelector('.scrollzone'); if (!z) return 'NOZONE'; return z.scrollHeight > z.clientHeight ? 'overflows' : 'flat:' + z.scrollHeight + '/' + z.clientHeight; })()
actions.note: 60 tabs must outgrow the zone or there is nothing to measure

actions.expression: (() => { const z = document.querySelector('.scrollzone'); if (!z) return 'NOZONE'; const st = {sumDy: 0, events: 0, top0: z.scrollTop}; window.__followprobe = st; z.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => { st.events++; st.sumDy += e.deltaY; }, {passive: true}); return 'ARMED'; })()

actions.note: cgevent scroll events land at the cursor, so park it on the rows first
a second identical gesture: cgevent delivery is flaky per gesture in the VM, and the verdict compares moved against whatever actually arrived, so both landing is as fine as one

actions.expression: (() => { const z = document.querySelector('.scrollzone'); const st = window.__followprobe; if (!z || !st) return 'NOSTATE'; const moved = Math.round(z.scrollTop - st.top0); const sum = Math.round(st.sumDy); if (st.events === 0) return 'NOEVENTS'; return moved === sum && sum > 100 ? 'followed' : 'lagged:' + moved + '/' + sum; })()

assertions.desc: THE CONTROL: the list is taller than the zone

THE RULE: scrollTop moved by exactly the deltas the page received, and the gesture was a real one (over 100px arrived). NOEVENTS means the gesture never landed - a cursor parking problem, not a scroll one.
